body:
Running the full `public_2507` suite (910 scenes), one scene consistently fails during NRE backend creation, so the run completes with 909 scenes.

Environment:

- AlpaSim: `01d6a5c`
- NRE image: `nvcr.io/nvidia/nre/nre-ga:26.02`
- Scene: `clipgt-b0ca8b13-0362-45e7-a1d1-f40d22f3340c`
- Dataset: `sample_set/25.07_release`
- NRE version: `25.7.9-b85d0efd`

Error:

```text
[ERROR] Failed to create backend for clipgt-b0ca8b13-0362-45e7-a1d1-f40d22f3340c
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "nre/grpc/<unknown>", line 0, in get_backend
  File "nre/grpc/<unknown>", line 0, in put_with_retries
  File "nre/grpc/<unknown>", line 0, in <lambda>
  File "nre/grpc/<unknown>", line 0, in from_artifact
  File "nre/render/<unknown>", line 0, in load_from_artifact
  File "nre/render/<unknown>", line 0, in _load_model_and_upgrade
  File "nre/render/<unknown>", line 0, in _load_model_gaussians_composite_and_upgrade
  File "nre/models/gaussians/<unknown>", line 0, in load_state_dict
  File ".../torch/nn/modules/module.py", line 2593, in load_state_dict
    raise RuntimeError(
RuntimeError: Error(s) in loading state_dict for GaussiansComposite:
    Unexpected key(s) in state_dict: "gaussians_nodes.dynamic_rigids.time_embed.timestamps_us_ranges".
```

From the upgrade log, our hypothesis is that there may be an internal inconsistency around `dynamic_rigids`: the upgrade path adds `time_embed.timestamps_us_ranges`, but the layer's only track is then filtered out (`1 available tracks → Filtered to 0 tracks`). The layer is skipped afterward (`positions tensor not found`), leaving an orphaned key that fails strict `load_state_dict`.

This is deterministic across 3 independent runs.

Is this a known issue? Is there anything we should do on our side, such as denylisting this scene or enabling a flag to tolerate empty `dynamic_rigids`, or is this fixed in a newer NRE image / asset revision?

comments.body:
Thanks! This is not a known issue. I'll forward the info to the nurec team.

In the meantime, if this is blocking you, you can remove that entry from the scene set `data/scenes/sim_scenes.csv`

I think this is no longer relevant for current `main`. The default public suite now uses the `public_2601` catalog and NRE-GA 26.04, and this scene points to a newer `26.01_release` asset.

The original report was against the legacy `public_2507` / `25.07_release` asset, which may still fail if someone explicitly opts into the legacy 2505/2507 CSVs. Since that legacy catalog is no longer the default, I’m going to close this as superseded. Please reopen if the same scene fails with the current `public_2601` catalog.

title: public_2507 scene fails during NRE backend creation with unexpected dynamic_rigids key
